title: Mixing colours

predict.prompt: Red and yellow paint mix to make orange. What colour will red light and green light make?

try: PAINT: tap the pots to drop paint into the bowl. LIGHT: tap the torches to shine them on the wall.
result: Paint: red and yellow made orange, blue and yellow made green, and all three made brown. Light: red and green light made yellow, and all three lights made white.
why: Paint mixes by taking light away. Each paint soaks up some colours of light and bounces back the rest, so the more paints you mix, the darker it gets: all three make brown.
Light mixes by adding. Red and green light together look yellow to our eyes, and red, green and blue light together look white.
Look at a phone or TV screen with a magnifying glass: every picture is made of tiny red, green and blue lights!
